From short poems to novels, we'll workshop new ideas and share constructive feedback together in a supportive writing space with comfortable furniture, friends, and background music.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Drop-In 3D Design & Printing
programs.blurb: In this drop-in activity, students will explore free 3D design software like Tinkercad and Blender to create unique designs for animation or 3D printing. Once they're satisfied with their creations, they'll learn to set up Powderhorn Park's 3D Printers and watch their designs come to life!

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Drop-In Digital Art & Design
programs.blurb: Drop in any time on Tuesday afternoons to experiment with Powderhorn's digital art and design software like Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Blender, and more. Learn color and composition and typography tricks from a professional graphic designer or just experiment with custom doodles until your creative energy is spent.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Drop-In Graphic Design
programs.blurb: Explore the world of Graphic Design! Use our computers, illustration tablet, and creative programs to design something new. Design a T-shirt, make a card, create a poster for your room, or even design a logo for your own brand.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Dungeons & Dragons (November & December)
programs.blurb: Immerse yourself further into the world of D&D at Whittier's Spark'd Studio! Each week we'll meet to play a campaign and do character building, while using our computers to create and print your own character sheet. All are welcome to join this great community of people!

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Dungeons & Dragons (September & October)

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Dungeons & Dragons Club at Powderhorn
programs.blurb: Dungeons and Dragons is a role-playing fantasy game that requires time, patience, dedication, and a big imagination. Students will work together to build a team and create worlds to adventure in with a little help from official D&D guidebooks.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Intro to 3D Design
programs.blurb: We'll use computer design programs such as "Blender" and “Tinker CAD” to develop 3D designs. Play around with shapes and create your own designs! No previous experience is required, and all technology is provided. Questions? Email: sparkd@minneapolisparks.org

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Intro to Audio Recording Workshop at Graco
programs.blurb: Learn the basics of audio production and record a short podcast episode, song, or audio drama in this workshop at the Spark'd Studio at Graco Park. Youth will learn podcasting structure, audio storytelling techniques, and how to use recording equipment. Youth will use our full recording studio, Scarlett Audio Interfaces or TASCAM to record their project. No previous experience required. Open to ages 11-16.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Intro to Book Arts Workshop at Graco Park
programs.blurb: At the Spark'd Studio at Graco Park, learn about book arts and make your own custom journal in this workshop on December 17th from 5-7pm . We’ll discuss different types of paper, book forms, and binding methods. No previous experience required. Open to ages 11-16.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Intro to Hand Sewing Workshop at Graco Park
programs.blurb: Learn the basics of hand sewing and make a small plush toy in this workshop at the Spark'd Studio at Graco Park. No previous experience required. Open to ages 11-16.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Intro to Laser Engraving at Graco (Nov.)
programs.blurb: Come try out the laser engraver November 4th and 18th from 4-5pm at the Spark’d Studio at Graco Park! A xTool S1 Diode Laser, the machine can cut and engrave materials such as wood, leather, MDF, opaque acrylic, and metal. Youth can design and engrave their own custom keychain or bring their own materials. This program is intended to create items for personal use, not commercial products. Open to ages 10-18.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Intro to Music Production
programs.blurb: Learn the ins and outs of Music Production at Whittier's studio! Become comfortable working with an audio recording interface, GarageBand music production software, Midi keyboards, and recording technology to create your own beat or song. In this program we will produce 3-5 tracks together. All levels of experience are welcome to participate.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Intro to Photo Editing Workshop at Graco
programs.blurb: Learn the basics photo editing at the Spark'd Studio at Graco Park on November 5th from 5-7pm . Work through guided tutorials with an instructor to learn how to retouch images, remove backgrounds, and add visual effects using Canva or Adobe Photoshop. Open to ages 11-16.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Intro to Podcasting
programs.blurb: Join us for Podcasting and Audio Recording. Youth will be introduced podcasting structure, storytelling, and debate. Youth will learn about audio quality, gains, levels, and microphone types. Youth will use our full recording studio, Scarlett Audio Interfaces or TASCAM to record their podcast.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Intro to Screen Printing Workshop at Graco
programs.blurb: At Graco Park Spark'd Studio, this hands-on workshop offers youth ages 11-16 the opportunity to explore screen printing! Participants can create their own simple design to print onto a t-shirt or tote bag to take home. Screen printing is the process of transferring a stenciled design on a flat surface with ink, a mesh screen, and a squeegee. This activity does involve ink, so please dress in clothes that can get dirt

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Intro to Video Editing Workshop at Graco
programs.blurb: Learn the basics video editing at the Spark'd Studio at Graco Park on December 3rd from 5-7pm . Work through guided tutorials with an instructor to learn how to edit videos and add graphics, music, and sound effects using iMovie or Adobe Premiere Pro. Open to ages 11-16.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Intro to Video Production Workshop at Graco
programs.blurb: Learn the basics of video production and record a short video project in this workshop at the Spark'd Studio at Graco Park. Youth will learn about pre-production, visual storytelling, and video production equipment. Canon DSLR cameras, TASCAM audio recorders, and LED light panels will be used to record their video. No previous experience required. Open to ages 11-16.

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Karaoke
programs.blurb: Join us for an exciting evening filled with music, laughter, and unforgettable performances. Bring your friends and sing your favorites songs together. Whether you're a seasoned performer or just starting out, our welcoming atmosphere and supportive crowd will make you feel like a star! Come sing some tunes on Thursday nights in October or again in December!

programs.name: Spark'd Studios: Mario Kart 8 Youth Tournament
programs.blurb: Drive, drift, and dodge your way to the finish in another Mario Kart 8 Tournament at Powderhorn! Players will get 30 minutes of free play to earn their rank before the double-elimination bracket begins. The top three players will go home with 3D-printed bronze, silver, and gold Mario Kart Trophies. Do you have what it takes?

Youth will learn the basics of personal training, muscle, ligaments, and tendon's function, and nutrition. The workouts will be focused on High Intensity Interval training with a mix of plyometrics.

programs.blurb: Join us in practicing self care club Relax and paint your nails, do a face mask, We will learn basic about taking care of yourself so you could be the best version of you.

programs.name: Youthline STEM Explorers
programs.blurb: Each week the group will dig into a fun science-based activity! This will range from things like building miniature catapults to making ice cream.

programs.name: Youthline Teen Drop In
programs.blurb: Bored at home or tired of hanging out in the house come and chill out with staff and peers at the park.

programs.name: Youthline Teen Open Gym
programs.blurb: 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, 4v4, 5v5 come hoop, play dodgeball, badminton, and more to pass the time or keep occupied. Either way we are here to have fun.

programs.name: Youthline Teen Trivia
programs.blurb: Get your thinking caps on as we play some weekly trivia! Each week will have four rounds of trivia starting at 5:00, 5:30, 6:00, and 6:30PM. Using Kahoot Triva youth will put their knowledge to the test and after each round the top three players will get small prizes!

programs.name: Youthline Thanksgiving Bingo
programs.blurb: Join us at Peavey park for Thanksgiving Bingo. Grab your bingo cards and get ready to have fun as we call out Thanksgiving themed words. The first to get Five in a row wins a prize. Lets enjoy Bingo and have fun together!

programs.name: Youthline-E-sports
programs.blurb: Join us at Philips Park to some competitive gaming in Madden, NBA 2k, Rocket League, UFC, & FIFA. Rankings will be posted at the beginning of each week.

programs.blurb: Cardinal Crew is a youth leadership program for students in grades 8–10 designed to give young people a meaningful voice in the planning and development of recreation programming. programs.name: Youthline: DIY Bath Soaps
programs.blurb: Join us at Peavey Recreation Center as we DIY soap bombs. Combines bath bomb fizz with soap's moisturizing benefits. Easy to customize it with colors, scents and essential oils for a relaxing and personalized bath experience. Perfect for home self-care for yourself or a loved one.

programs.name: Youthline: Drop In with Ahmed
programs.blurb: Drop in, chill, and hang with Ahmed! As we play games, work on crafts , and try out different forms of art. From painting, drawing, crafting, beading, clay and more! We will explore a variety of art mediums and have a new project to either display at Phillips or take home each week.

programs.name: Youthline: Field Trips
programs.blurb: Luxton Park Youthline will take trips to various locations around Minneapolis, such as Urban Air, professional sports games, the Minnesota Zoo, Science Museum, Wirth Lake, and more! Please check in with Youthline staff on upcoming trips. Time's and dates vary.

programs.name: Youthline: GameCraft Explorers
programs.blurb: Youth ages 12-17 can engage in friendly competition through a variety of activities including board games, card games, dominos, and ping pong. Not only are these games enjoyable, but they also foster the development of critical thinking, strategy, counting, and social interaction skills.

programs.name: Youthline: Hawthorne Hoops Haven
programs.blurb: This program is designed to help young athletes ages 12-17 improve their shooting mechanics, increase shooting volume, and develop overall basketball skills. By incorporating the Dr. Dish Basketball Shooting Machine, athletes will have the opportunity to take hundreds of shots per session, focus on technique, and simulate game-like situations for improved performance on the court.

programs.blurb: Homework Hustle is an academic support and enrichment program designed for youth ages 12–17. programs.name: Youthline: XBOX Dancer
programs.blurb: Tiktok dancer? Join us as we dance to XBOX One dances. We will be recreating all new dances we see on TIKTOK.
